purpose: Baseline population initialization, independent of the policy evaluation outcomes.

source.title: 2017 지역사회건강조사 서울시 건강통계
source.transcribed_from: user_policy_html, cross-checked against the official Seoul PDF figure 10
source.verification_note: 서울시 공식 배포 PDF 인쇄 p30 정의/표14와 p31 그림10을 확인했고 모든 성별×연령 값은 그림 렌더링으로 대조했다. 첨부된 금연구역 정책 평가 PDF와는 별개 자료다.

definition: 조사대상 응답자 중 평생 담배 5갑(100개비) 이상을 피웠고 현재 매일 또는 가끔 담배를 피우는 사람의 분율
rate_type: crude prevalence for Seoul sex/age strata; district map intervals are age-standardized and are not applied as quotas

survey.method: Trained interviewers visited sampled households and conducted one-to-one CAPI interviews.
survey.target_population: Residents aged 19 or older in sampled households
survey.denominator: Respondents to the indicator, with nonresponses excluded and survey weights applied; not all lifetime smokers.
survey.weighting: Household and person nonresponse weights, calibrated to July 2017 resident-register sex/age structure, with extreme-weight adjustment.

assignment.recommended_method: seeded quota within sex and age band
assignment.unknown_age: reject or record an explicit imputation; never silently use age 19
assignment.note: These are observed population prevalence rates. Individual simulated smoking labels are assigned, not measured for real named persons; they are not facility-user smoking prevalence or behavioral response coefficients.
